ai_descriptions.label: Generate descriptions with AI
ai_descriptions.description: When a provider with AI support is available, use it to write a natural-language description for each smart playlist. Falls back to a plain rules summary when no AI provider is available.

manifest.description: Create dynamic or fixed playlists based on rules: genres, artists, albums, favorites, similar tracks, release year, album type, explicit content, track duration, and rediscover forgotten tracks by filtering out recently played music.

errors.invalid_name: {0} is not a valid playlist name.
